paper.title_en: Some new observations on catalan ideal convergent sequence spaces via neutrosophic normed spaces
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce the concepts of neutrosophic Catalan I-convergent sequence space $\mathcal {R}_{(\mathcal {G})}^{I}(\mathscr {S})$, neutrosophic Catalan I-null convergent sequence space $\mathcal {R}_{(\mathcal {G})}^{I^{0}}(\mathscr {S})$, and neutrosophic Catalan I-bounded sequence space $\mathcal {R}_{(\mathcal {G})}^{I^{\infty }}(\mathscr {S})$ in neutrosophic normed spaces by using the notions of convergent sequences (c), null sequences $(c_{0})$, bounded sequences $(l_{\infty })$, and the domain of the regular Catalan matrix $\mathscr {S}=({b}_{nk})$. Furthermore, we investigate the concept of neutrosophic Catalan I-Cauchy sequences in neutrosophic normed spaces. We also define open balls $\mathscr {B}_{x}^{I}(t,\epsilon )(\mathscr {S})$ and closed balls $\mathscr {B}_{x}^{I}[t,\epsilon ](\mathscr {S})$, and study several algebraic and topological properties of these newly defined sequence spaces.
